what: compare_methods(cavity_volume, distance_from_source_negated) re-measured under protocol version 3+, replacing the version-2 example quoted in manifest.yaml, ADR 0025, CONTRIBUTING.md and experiments/REGISTRY.md.
how: score_arm and compare_methods at the frozen protocol, cavity_volume from decoys.detect_pockets at the frozen detector_settings, distance_from_source_negated as the negated minimum CA distance to the source set.
reading: The gap moved on every arm because ADR 0030 re-froze the detector and cavity_volume is computed from that detector's cavities. The point the manifest comment makes survives and strengthens: on kras_g12c_corrected a +0.255 AUC gap reads p = 0.83, so comparing two AUC values would still have called a non-result a win. bcr_abl1_corrected no longer clears alpha once calibrated (0.0550).
